title: Playboy Magazine Lot 4 Anna Nicole Smith La Toya Jackson + 1 Extra Magazine
descriptionText:
Description:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines from 1989–1994. Includes March 1989 La Toya Jackson, May 1993 Dian Parkinson, January 1994 40th Anniversary Collector’s Edition, and February 1994 Anna Nicole Smith.

Pre-owned vintage condition with normal age/storage wear including possible scuffs, scratches, edge/corner wear and creasing. Please review photos carefully for exact condition and contents. Sold together as the exact lot pictured.
